# Diagram Studio

> Grid diagrams that cannot overlap: nodes sit in cells, edges route only through the
> gutters between rows and columns. Built for coding agents: a share link, a one-file
> Python CLI, and an embeddable engine — no account, no install required for the link.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/agents.md): full spec reference, delivery
  paths (share link / CLI / embed) with exact code, worked examples, and the lint-to-fix table.
- [JSON Schema](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/spec.schema.json): every spec field, JSON
  Schema draft 2020-12.

## Tools

- [dgs](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/dgs): self-contained Python 3 (stdlib only) CLI —
  `lint`, `render` (svg/png/html/figure), `link`, `place`, `schema`, `icons`, `example`.
- [diagram.js](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/diagram.js): the rendering engine. Dependency-free;
  inline it verbatim in any page.
- [Claude Code / Codex skill](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/skill/SKILL.md)

## Examples

- [webapp.json](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/examples/webapp.json): a 6-node request path.
- [pipeline.json](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/examples/pipeline.json): `flow: right`.
- [zone.json](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/examples/zone.json): two zones.
- [auth-flow.json](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/examples/auth-flow.json): a highlighted path, slide scale.

## Optional

- [Studio](https://diagram-studio.bibas.dev/app): the visual (human, mouse-driven) editor.
